title: 25 November 2026 Artifact Wave
summary: Here is what we got as new Jetpack artifacts this week!
content:
The clogged drain holding up the Compose 1.13.0 stable release was cleared late last week, so those artifacts showed up in today’s scan.

In addition, statestore-datastore is now multiplatform:

  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-desktop
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-iosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-iossimulatorarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-js
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-linuxarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-linuxx64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-macosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-tvosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-tvossimulatorarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-wasm-js
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchosdevicearm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchossimulatorarm64

Plus, we got some new Remote Compose artifacts and something for Nav3 that seems truly dynamic:

  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation-compose-android
  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation-compose-jvm
  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-generator
  • androidx.navigation3:navigation3-dynamic-features

Overall, we got around 900 artifact updates.

If you are in the United States, I hope that you have a Merry Thanksgiving! If you reside elsewhere, I hope you have a great day too!
